title: Role Privilege Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the database role privilege policy. Enforces: no superuser application roles, no DDL privileges (DROP/TRUNCATE/ALTER) for app roles, no ALL PRIVILEGES wildcard, PII tables require row-level security flag, migration roles are separated from application roles, and analytics roles are strictly read-only.

error_codes.RPP001: role-privilege-policy.json missing or invalid — required fields: roles[] with name, privileges[], tables[]
error_codes.RPP002: Application service role has superuser: true — application roles must never have superuser privileges
error_codes.RPP003: Application role has DDL privilege (DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER, CREATE) — only migration roles may hold DDL rights
error_codes.RPP004: Role uses ALL PRIVILEGES wildcard — enumerate specific privileges explicitly; wildcards make auditing impossible
error_codes.RPP005: Role accesses PII-tier table without row_level_security: required flag — RLS is mandatory for all PII table access
error_codes.RPP006: Migration role and application role share the same account — migration and runtime credentials must be separate
error_codes.RPP007: Analytics role has write privileges (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) — analytics roles must be strictly SELECT-only
